memories.content: Use the same term throughout the proposal for the same interaction concept or interface element.
Use abbreviations only for recurring terms of three or more words.
Present the full name and abbreviation together when using an abbreviation for the first time.
Prioritize the research role over diagnostic labels or deficits when referring to participants.
Reviewers from different subfields struggle to infer undefined abbreviations from context alone.
Use the term formative evaluation for studies seeking design modification evidence, and distinguish it from final efficacy judgments.
The user can have contribution labels such as principles, models, or guidelines approved only if they align with the abstraction level of the actual deliverables.
Design principles describe the relationship between conditions and outcomes rather than serving as instructions that merely replicate a single screen layout.
List whom to notify and in what order if serious discomfort is reported during the study.
Field staff rely on the pre-defined contact sequence when serious discomfort is reported.
Define the thresholds for participant harm, operational disruption, and data anomalies at which deployment and data collection must cease.
Establish procedures to restore existing systems and workflow states after suspending field deployment.
The user's stop plan can be judged feasible only when it identifies who has authority to order recovery and who is responsible for carrying it out.

In organizations where error reporting is linked to individual performance evaluations, safety signal records may be separated from research decision logs, potentially breaking the traceability path for the same incident.

analysis.overview: The frames address separate governance domains. The reference frame sets proposal-language, participant-framing, study-labeling, and contribution-label standards, while the compared frame covers serious-discomfort escalation, stopping thresholds, operational recovery, recovery ownership, and incident traceability risks. No cross-frame contradiction or shared operational claim appears.

reports.compared_only: The compared frame uniquely governs serious-discomfort escalation, mandatory stopping thresholds, system recovery procedures and ownership, and traceability risks created by separating safety records from decision logs.
reports.reference_only: The reference uniquely governs consistent terminology, abbreviation discipline, participant-respectful language, formative-evaluation naming, and contribution labels matched to deliverable abstraction.
